# 7th ALMA Awards (Spain)

The 7th ALMA Awards ceremony, presented by ALMA, the screenwriters' union of Spain, was held on 20 March 2024 at the  in Madrid. The gala was written and hosted by Yaiza Nuevo and Javi Valera.
The committee of the Writers Guild of America responsible for negotiating in the 2023 Writers Guild of America strike was awarded the ALMA Honorary Award.
